## [1.0.1](https://github.com/klconsultancy/opencode-copilot-auto/compare/v1.0.0...v1.0.1) (2026-10-21)


### Continuous Integration

* stage npm releases for maintainer approval ([f315e46](https://github.com/klconsultancy/opencode-copilot-auto/commit/f315e467367d7992127ad797c4fd6a31baa5fa1c))

First release of @klconsultancy/opencode-copilot-auto, continuing [m0wer/opencode-github-copilot-auto-model](https://github.com/m0wer/opencode-github-copilot-auto-model).

- One package for opencode 1 (`server`, >= 1.18.29) and opencode 2 (`setup`).
- Routes each conversation through Copilot's `POST /auto`, like VS Code and Copilot CLI.
- One picker model per Auto tier: `auto` (balance), `auto-efficiency`, `auto-intelligence`.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@klconsultancy/opencode-copilot-auto/v/1.0.0
